descriptions.d25j_create_from_defs_8017c788: For each 20-byte definition gets an object from service lookup 0x8020b680 under one of two keys chosen by flag 8 at +16, initializes it through 0x80187158 or 0x801702b8 and passes it to 0x8017c464, marking failure on a zero result; raises global 0x804ab5e8 to the value at +9752 when larger; returns 0, or 0x80004005 after any failure.
